gaps.sentence: He's brilliant ___ solving all kinds of puzzles.
gaps.explanation: Adjectives of skill take 'at': brilliant at something.

gaps.sentence: The whole project hinges ___ council approval.
I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.
shout AT somebody = be aggressive; shout TO = call so they hear.

gaps.sentence: The song reminds me ___ my first holiday abroad.
gaps.explanation: remind somebody OF something = make them remember; remind somebody ABOUT = tell them not to forget.

gaps.sentence: Over two hundred athletes participated ___ the marathon.
gaps.explanation: participate IN an event (also: take part in).

gaps.sentence: She was completely oblivious ___ the commotion outside.
gaps.explanation: 'Oblivious to' is the standard collocation meaning unaware of.
